source_notes: The Open University publishes the Q01 qualification structure (stages, credits, module codes and titles) on its public course pages. Each module's own unit-by-unit content, module guide and assessment criteria sit behind the OU's student VLE and were not accessible; the detailed topic content taught here follows the standard, well-established historical narrative and historiographical debate for each period, as found in any history-degree textbook, module descriptor or reading list, cross-checked against the QAA Subject Benchmark Statement for History (2022). Stage tests and the mock are original questions in undergraduate-history style, never real OU TMA/EMA questions.
